headline: 90% of Indian employers plan to expand tech workforce to tap AI opportunities: Report
summary: A Randstad report reveals that 90% of Indian employers plan to expand their technology workforce to capitalize on AI opportunities, placing India second globally behind the US in hiring intentions. This demand is driving up compensation for specialized AI developers while prompting companies to rely heavily on flexible talent and digital marketplaces. Concurrently, traditional hiring patterns are shifting, with 44% of surveyed organizations recruiting fewer entry-level developers than two years ago.

headline: Guidance Tamil Nadu denies mass resignations, says employee exits were routine
summary: Guidance Tamil Nadu, the state's official investment promotion agency, has refuted media reports alleging mass resignations within the organization. The agency clarified that recent departures were part of routine employee turnover driven by personal reasons such as career advancement, higher education, and relocation. While defending its attrition rates as normal workforce movement, it did not disclose the exact number of recent exits.

headline: TCS employee alleges denial of office entry over Ayyappa Deeksha attire
summary: An employee at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) in Hyderabad was reportedly denied office entry for wearing traditional attire while observing Ayyappa Deeksha. HR personnel cited dress code guidelines and client perception concerns, prompting brief peaceful protests before police helped resolve the misunderstanding. The incident highlights the operational and legal challenges private companies face when balancing workplace dress codes with employees' religious practices.

headline: Remote makes AI training mandatory for 2,000 employees
summary: HR technology firm Remote has introduced mandatory AI training for its 2,000 employees, allocating five hours of paid work time to complete the introductory program. To ensure accountability, CEO Job van der Voort tied course completion directly to employee performance reviews, arguing that companies have a responsibility to upskill their existing workforce in emerging technologies.

headline: Srijan STYLE ropes in Anindita Ghosh as head-HR
summary: Srijan STYLE has appointed Anindita Ghosh as its head of human resources to oversee the people function at the fashion and lifestyle retailer. Ghosh brings over a decade of experience across HR, administration, and marketing, having previously worked at organizations such as Merlin Group, SUPER IRON FOUNDRY, and Kiswok Industries. She holds a master's degree in human resources from Manipal University Jaipur.

headline: Reshmi Prakash joins Zapcom Group as director-HR
summary: Zapcom Group Inc. has appointed Reshmi Prakash as its Director of HR, where she will oversee global talent acquisition, HR operations, and employee engagement. Prakash brings 14 years of industry experience, most recently serving as associate director at NoBroker.com. Her career also includes HR leadership roles at Sunovaa Tech, Azuga, Concentrix, and Altisource.

headline: Spotify sticks to work-from-anywhere policy, citing flexibility and workforce benefits
summary: Spotify is continuing its flexible "Work From Anywhere" policy despite a broader corporate trend toward mandatory office returns. The audio streaming platform reports key benefits from the model, including a 15 per cent decrease in employee turnover, faster recruitment, and access to a wider talent pool. The ongoing policy has also prompted the company to optimize its global real estate footprint while maintaining periodic in-person team gatherings.

headline: POV: Is AI making work better, or simply raising productivity expectations?
summary: As AI tools accelerate routine business tasks, organizations face a choice between raising output expectations or allowing employees time for higher-level strategic thinking. HR leaders emphasize that leadership intent determines whether AI improves the workplace experience or merely increases workload pressure. Ultimately, effective integration requires using saved time to foster critical thinking and refine judgment rather than just demanding higher output volume.

headline: Canva layoffs: Is the real workforce reduction bigger than reported?
summary: Reports suggest Canva's recent workforce reduction may be larger than the officially announced 1,271 roles due to earlier exits and unreplaced vacancies. Scrutiny has also focused on potential severance disparities and whether performance reviews or AI influenced departures, though Canva has denied using performance management to cut headcount. The situation underscores the growing challenges of maintaining transparency and trust during complex, AI-era corporate restructurings.

headline: Welspun elevates Ravi Singh to CHRO
summary: Welspun has promoted Ravi Singh to Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO), effective December 2026. Singh, who joined the conglomerate in May 2023, previously served as Senior Vice President and Head of Global Talent Solutions. His appointment aligns with the company's strategy to place talent acquisition, leadership capability, and workforce readiness at the center of its global expansion.

headline: Tata Steel elevates Mukesh Agarwal to chief L&D and chief wellness officer
summary: Tata Steel has elevated Mukesh Agarwal to the dual role of Chief Learning & Development (L&D) and Chief Wellness Officer. In his new position, the 20-year company veteran will lead capability development across technical, digital, managerial, and leadership domains for Tata Steel India. The strategic promotion reflects Tata Steel's commitment to integrating workforce transformation, continuous learning, and employee well-being as connected organizational priorities.

headline: EPFO’s new retirement plan: More choice, less pressure
summary: The Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) is proposing a voluntary Systematic Withdrawal Plan allowing retirees to receive their PF savings in regular installments while continuing to earn interest. Additionally, the EPFO plans to reduce the unemployment withdrawal waiting period back to two months and enable direct digital contributions for gig and informal workers. The organization has also approved in-principle plans to invest a small portion of new inflows into government-backed startup funds.

headline: Can Nvidia remain Nvidia without Jensen Huang?
summary: Following an internal investigation into personal conduct, long-time CEO Jensen Huang has unexpectedly resigned from Nvidia after leading the company for thirty-three years. CFO Colette Kress has taken over as interim chief executive while the board searches for a permanent successor amidst mixed employee reactions. The sudden departure highlights broader challenges surrounding corporate identity and leadership continuity when a charismatic founder exits.

headline: P&G plans to cut manufacturing and logistics workforce by up to 30% by 2030
summary: Procter & Gamble plans to reduce its manufacturing and logistics workforce by 20% to 30% by 2030 as part of a $10 billion productivity initiative. The company is expanding its use of automation to help offset rising commodity expenses, inflation, and slowing earnings growth. This strategy follows a previous restructuring program that eliminated 7,000 office-based roles.

headline: Cisco cuts less than 1% of workforce in latest layoff round
summary: Cisco executed another round of targeted layoffs in November, affecting less than 1% of its global workforce. This latest reduction follows larger job cuts earlier in the year as the networking company restructures to prioritize high-growth areas like artificial intelligence. Through these workforce adjustments, Cisco aims to improve operational efficiency and significantly increase its revenue per employee.

headline: Sahitya Aaj Tak 2026 to be held in New Delhi from November 27 to 29
summary: The 2026 edition of the Sahitya Aaj Tak literary festival will take place in New Delhi from November 27 to 29. Organized by the India Today Group, the three-day event will feature discussions across literature, politics, cinema, and artificial intelligence, alongside cultural performances and an awards ceremony.

headline: Xtendr partners with JioStar for XR-based fan engagement campaign
summary: Technology company Xtendr has partnered with JioStar to launch 'Your Star Moment,' an Extended Reality (XR) campaign powered by Xtendr's bitom platform. The initiative allows television viewers to virtually interact and create personalized photos with regional celebrities using green-screen technology, bypassing the need for physical travel. By converting screens into interactive surfaces, the campaign modernizes the traditional meet-and-greet format across JioStar's digital channels.

headline: BBDO Group India appoints Ashish Chakravarty as Chief Creative Officer
summary: BBDO Group India has appointed industry veteran Ashish Chakravarty as its new Chief Creative Officer. Chakravarty brings over two decades of advertising experience, having previously held senior leadership roles at Garage Worldwide, McCann, and Contract Advertising. In his new role, he will work alongside Group CCO Josy Paul and CEO Jitender Dabas to drive creative innovation and business solutions across the agency's client portfolio.

headline: Parle Monaco teams up with SOCIAL for a biscuit-inspired menu
summary: Parle Products' biscuit brand Monaco has partnered with restaurant chain SOCIAL to launch a special menu across India featuring the biscuit as a key culinary ingredient. The initiative aims to expand Monaco beyond traditional packaged snacking to engage Gen Z consumers and create new consumption occasions.

headline: Usha International extends MI Emirates partnership for 2026–27
summary: Usha International has extended its partnership with cricket franchise MI Emirates for the 2026–27 International T20 League season in the UAE. This renewal builds on Usha's four-season association with the team and a broader 13-year relationship with the MI Global Family. As part of the deal, Usha will conduct fan engagement initiatives, digital contests, and match-day branding activations.

headline: Aahana Dhar from Airbnb joins Anthropic as Communications Lead, India
summary: Aahana Dhar has been appointed as the Communications Lead for India at Anthropic, taking on the role in November 2026. She transitions from Airbnb, where she served as Head of Communications for India and Southeast Asia. Dhar brings extensive communications experience across both corporate and non-profit sectors, including previous leadership roles at Coca-Cola, Tinder, and Uber.

headline: OpenAI elevates Akash Iyer as head of social for APAC
summary: OpenAI has promoted Akash Iyer to Head of Social for the Asia-Pacific (APAC) region, expanding his previous role as the company's India social lead. Iyer brings over 14 years of experience in digital marketing and content production to the position, having previously held senior media roles at Netflix, BuzzFeed, and Sportskeeda.

headline: Blissclub challenges dress codes with ‘The Wrong Outfit’ campaign
summary: Activewear and lifestyle brand Blissclub has launched a new marketing campaign titled 'The Wrong Outfit,' featuring actor Sobhita Dhulipala. The campaign challenges traditional dress codes by encouraging women to prioritize comfort and personal style over conventional occasion-based expectations. Through this initiative, Blissclub highlights its product expansion into everyday apparel designed for versatility across various settings.

headline: Zenith appoints Milan Modi as associate vice president
summary: Zenith has appointed Milan Modi as Associate Vice President, where he will lead digital media strategy, investment, and planning for L'Oréal's Dermatological Beauty and Luxe portfolios. Modi brings over 13 years of digital marketing and analytics experience to the position. Prior to joining Zenith, he held senior paid media roles at PivotRoots and spent over five years at Madison World.

headline: Story Digital bags digital mandate  for Secret Temptation
summary: Story Digital has been appointed as the social media agency for Secret Temptation, a personal care brand under McNROE Consumer Products. The mandate covers social media strategy, content creation, and digital collaborations aimed at establishing a culturally relevant presence for young women. This appointment expands Story Digital's existing relationship with McNROE, which already includes managing its Wild Stone and CODE brands.

headline: NFDC & SPNI invite content pitches through WAVES Bazaar
summary: The National Film Development Corporation (NFDC) and Sony Pictures Networks India (SPNI) have partnered to launch a content pitching initiative via the WAVES Bazaar portal. Announced at the 57th International Film Festival of India, the project invites writers and production houses to submit original fiction and unscripted concepts across five languages. NFDC will process and shortlist the entries, giving selected creators the opportunity to pitch directly to SPNI for potential development.

headline: MARS Cosmetics partners with Meta for brand-creator discussion
summary: MARS Cosmetics partnered with Meta to host a discussion on the evolving landscape of brand-creator relationships at Meta's Gurugram office. Featuring prominent content creators, the event emphasized the importance of long-term collaborations, authentic storytelling, and involving creators early in the creative process. MARS Cosmetics highlighted its strategy of supporting creator vision over rigid briefs, building on its previous successful partnership with designer Nancy Tyagi at Cannes.

headline: Shubman Gill fronts Tata Capital's latest loan awareness campaign
summary: Tata Capital has launched a public awareness campaign titled 'Sawaal Karo, Phir Loan Lo', featuring Indian cricketer Shubman Gill to promote responsible borrowing. The initiative uses short films depicting everyday credit scenarios to encourage consumers to thoroughly evaluate loan terms and financial implications before borrowing. Aimed at balancing easy digital credit access with informed decision-making, the campaign stresses the importance of financial literacy.

headline: Food safety crackdown puts India’s cold chain in focus
source_publication: Transportation | Logistics | Aviation | Shipping | Supply Chain
summary: Recent food safety crackdowns in India, including widespread license suspensions in Maharashtra, have drawn attention to critical gaps in the nation's cold-chain infrastructure. In response, the FSSAI has issued strict guidelines demanding precise temperature controls across the perishable food supply chain. Industry experts note that primary hurdles remain logistical handovers and the lack of multi-commodity storage near growing urban consumption hubs.

headline: Mahindra targets greater visibility into supplier capacity
source_publication: Transportation | Logistics | Aviation | Shipping | Supply Chain
summary: Mahindra & Mahindra is expanding a supply chain transformation program using Kinaxis software to enhance demand forecasting, production efficiency, and delivery reliability across its automotive and farm divisions. The initiative focuses on moving away from manual spreadsheets toward direct system integrations while gaining deeper visibility into actual supplier manufacturing capacities. Though integrating AI and predictive analytics, the company emphasizes that human oversight remains critical to navigate sudden market shifts.
